Realisations of a fitted curve over a predictor grid

Source: R/toxval-pred.R
new_toxval_pred.Rd

A toxval_pred holds realisations of one or more fitted curves (posterior draws for a Bayesian fit, parametric bootstrap replicates for a frequentist one) evaluated over a common predictor grid. It is returned by toxval_predict() and can be passed to ecx() and nsec() in place of the fitted model.

Usage

new_toxval_pred(
  curves,
  keys,
  x_vec,
  meta,
  threshold = NULL,
  control = NULL,
  asymptote = NULL
)

Arguments

curves

An unnamed list of numeric matrices, one element per row of keys. Each matrix has one row per realisation and one column per value of x_vec.

keys

A data frame identifying the curves, one row per element of curves. See Identifying curves.

x_vec

A numeric vector of at least two finite, strictly increasing predictor values.

meta

A named list of metadata. See Metadata.

threshold

An unnamed list of numeric vectors of per-realisation values of a threshold parameter such as an NEC, one element per row of keys, or NULL where the model has none.

control

An unnamed list of numeric vectors of per-realisation control responses from a separate control-only fit, one element per row of keys, or NULL.

asymptote

An unnamed list, one element per row of keys, of lists of two numeric vectors of per-realisation asymptotes named decreasing (the lower asymptote) and increasing (the upper one), or NULL where the model supplies none. Used by type = "relative".

Value

An object of class toxval_pred, a list with elements curves, keys, x_vec, threshold, control, asymptote and meta.

Details

new_toxval_pred() builds one, and is for developers writing a toxval_predict() method for a new model class.

Identifying curves

Row i of keys identifies element i of curves, and of threshold, control and asymptote when they are supplied. The columns of keys are drawn from group and response, and become the descriptor columns of the result:

Ungrouped

One row and no columns, such as data.frame(row.names = 1L).

Grouped

A group column, a factor with one row per level.

Multivariate

A response column, a factor with one row per response.

Grouped multivariate

Both columns, with one row per combination of group and response.

Rows of keys are unique and contain no missing values.

Realisation alignment

Realisation i is the same posterior draw or bootstrap replicate in every slot: row i of every matrix in curves, and element i of every element of threshold, control and asymptote. new_toxval_pred() checks that the dimensions agree with meta$n_realisation and length(x_vec), but cannot check that the realisations themselves are aligned.

Metadata

meta must contain the following elements. Additional elements are permitted and ignored.

source_class

String, the class of the fitted object the realisations came from.

x_var

String, the name of the predictor variable.

group_var

String naming the grouping variable. Required when keys has a group column, and NULL otherwise.

multi_var

Character vector of the response names of a multivariate fit, including every level of keys$response. Required when keys has a response column, and NULL otherwise.

resolution

Whole number, the number of values in x_vec.

x_range

Numeric of length 2, the range of x_vec.

x_control

Number, the control concentration, at which the control response is predicted: the lowest predictor value in the data, unless the caller names another. It must be the first value of x_vec.

family

String naming the response distribution, such as the brms family or the type of a drc fit, or NULL. A multivariate fit whose responses differ in family gives a character vector named by response. A binomial family is taken to be on the proportion scale.

realisation

Either "draws" or "bootstrap".

n_realisation

Whole number, the number of realisations.

seed

Whole number, the seed used to generate bootstrap realisations or to choose the realisations of a model average, or NULL.

The following elements are optional, and are checked when they are present. A model average records them.

model_weights

Named numeric, the weight of each model in a model average, each between 0 and 1 and summing to 1. A model whose weight gives it no realisation is still listed.

draw_model

Character, one value per realisation, naming the model the realisation came from. Each value is a name in model_weights when that is present.

model_control

An unnamed list, one element per row of keys, of named lists of numeric vectors. Each vector holds the control response of one model in every draw of its own fit, including draws left out of the average, so its length can differ from n_realisation. It requires draw_model, and every model named there has a vector. Under anchor = "component", nsec() takes each model's reference from it.

Examples

new_toxval_pred(
  curves = list(matrix(c(10, 9, 8, 7, 11, 9, 7, 5), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)),
  keys = data.frame(row.names = 1L),
  x_vec = c(0, 1, 2, 3),
  meta = list(
    source_class = "brmsfit",
    x_var = "x",
    group_var = NULL,
    multi_var = NULL,
    resolution = 4,
    x_range = c(0, 3),
    x_control = 0,
    family = "gaussian",
    realisation = "draws",
    n_realisation = 2,
    seed = NULL
  )
)
#> <toxval_pred> brmsfit
#>   realisations: 2 (draws)
#>   grid:         x, 4 values from 0 to 3
#>   curves:       1 (ungrouped)
#>   threshold:    none
#>   control:      none
